Mastercard (MA) Stake Held by Northside Capital Management Llc; Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Maintains Holding in Apple (AAPL)
June 27, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Northside Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Mastercard Incorporated (MA) by 12.28% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northside Capital Management Llc bought 2,825 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.48% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 25,825 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.52M, up from 23,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northside Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Mastercard Incorporated for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $204.54B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.27% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $195.92. About 1.32M shares traded.
